A '''Pokémon Stylist''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンスタイリスト''' ''Pokémon Stylist''), also known as a '''Poké Stylist''' (Japanese: '''ポケリスト''' ''PokéList''), is a [[human|person]] who sketches and designs [[Accessory|clothing and accessories]] for {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. They can also create {{an|List of clothing|outfits}} for [[Pokémon Trainer]]s. According to [[Paris]], a Pokémon Stylist is one type of [[Pokémon Coordinator]].

==Role==
As pointed out by [[Hermione]] in ''[[DP086|Arriving in Style!]]'', Stylists and {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s have a very similar role, as both kinds of {{pkmn|Trainer}}s aim to showcase their Pokémon's charms in a stylish manner. It should be noted, however, that while a Coordinator concentrates on showing off a Pokémon's style by displaying its [[move]]s and skills in an appealing way, a Stylist focuses on designing clothing items that are likely to bring out a Pokémon's inner beauty and enhance their outward appearances.

Pokémon Stylists can also take part in {{cat|Pokémon competitions}} such as the [[Hearthome Collection]], a fashion show where contestants dress up and model their Pokémon in their own original designs. Additionally, they may open up their own fashion stores. The {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} is widely popular in [[Sinnoh]], but is also well-known in at least one other [[region]] of the [[Pokémon world]], as [[Lila]] said in ''[[DP095|Battling The Generation Gap!]]'' that she was given the chance to study to become a Pokémon Stylist abroad.

The {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Poké Chic}} fashion magazine is a publication that caters to Pokémon Stylists and trend-conscious Trainers. According to Hermione, Poké Chic's editor-in-chief, the public interest for Pokémon styling increased after [[Paris]] achieved success as a highly skilled Stylist. This inspired many people to become a Stylist as well.
